title: Kasner Singularities Beyond the Subcritical Regime
exact_target: Determine the singular behavior of small unrestricted perturbations of Kasner solutions outside the proven subcritical regime.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004805 (OWR-8415343-008). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/40, pp. 2157--2267. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The failure of the strict inequality includes the borderline equality case. Oscillatory behavior is a heuristic possibility, rather than an added asserted conclusion.
